name: Buzzy Bee
notes: DRAFT for C13-1 (bestiary-plan.md). Busy little bees in groups of 3-4 that zip in and out. Stats set in R-BAL-8 (#183). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
description: Busy little bees in groups of 3-4 that zip in and out.

bestiary.tip: Calm the little ones first. DASH out if they crowd you.

lore.yellow: The garden bees got mixed up in the shadow. Calm them, and they go back to the flowers.
